name: Toraware no Ie: Reinou Tantei Chousa File
original_name: 囚われの家 霊能探偵調査ファイル
source:
Undertaking a request to search for missing girls, I arrive at a house.
With my spiritual ability, I see three girls violated here in my spiritual vision.
I ought to rescue the girls and escape from this house.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ230289.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
